pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's lemma environment at source lines 31452-31464 (label lemma-geometrically-unibranch, whose reference environment records Etale coverings Lemma 2.2 and EGA IV Proposition 18.8.15): for a local ring with a strict henselization, being geometrically unibranch is equivalent to the strict henselization having a unique minimal prime. The proof environment at source lines 31466-31550 immediately follows it and is its own proof, written out directly and not only referred to the companion statement: the first direction contracts the minimal prime, reduces to the integral closure of the quotient, and contradicts non locality or a non purely inseparable residue field extension by placing a finitely generated subalgebra inside a domain while its tensor product with the strict henselization splits; the converse descends uniqueness of the minimal prime along localizations of etale algebras using the local normal domain obtained by tensoring the integral closure.
